Every control on the Settings page (the gear in the sidebar, `#/settings`; in the app also ⌘, or **Settings…** in
the menu), with its default. Theme and Hidden projects are stored in config.yml, so they work in the app and in a
browser. The others are stored in the app's UserDefaults domain under their key (`defaults read
io.github.altoption.ai-task-tracking <key>`), which the engine can't read: a browser shows them as *Only in the app*.

When the engine can't be reached, ⌘, opens a small window instead, with Launch at login and how to get the engine
back; it switches to the page once the engine answers.

## General

| Setting | Default | Where | Stored as |
|---|---|---|---|
| Launch at login | — (the app's macOS login item, not a UserDefaults key) | Only in the app; also in its fallback window | — |
| Show in the Dock | on | Only in the app | `showInDock` |
| Show Needs-you issues in the menu | on | Only in the app | `showNeedsYouInMenu` |
| Show stalled work in Needs you | on | Only in the app | `showStalledInNeedsYou` |
| Show CI status | on | Only in the app | `showCIStatus` |

## Appearance

| Setting | Default | Where | Stored as |
|---|---|---|---|
| Theme | Graphite (also Dark, Light, Match macOS, Midnight, Plum, Paper, High contrast and your theme files) | App and browser | `theme` in config.yml |

## Notifications

| Setting | Default | Where | Stored as |
|---|---|---|---|
| Notify me about agent activity | on | Only in the app | `notifications` |
| An agent needs me | on | Only in the app | `notifyNeedsYou` |
| An agent finished an issue | on | Only in the app | `notifyDone` |
| An agent created an issue | off | Only in the app | `notifyNew` |

## Projects

| Setting | Default | Where | Stored as |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hidden projects | none (one switch per project, and No project) | App and browser | `hiddenProjects` in config.yml |

## Shortcuts

| Setting | Default | Where | Stored as |
|---|---|---|---|
| Open AI Task Tracking window | on | Only in the app | `openWindowHotKey` |
| Open AI Task Tracking window: shortcut | ⌥⌘I (also ⌃⌥⌘I, ⌥⌘T) | Only in the app | `openWindowHotKeyPreset` |
| Quick capture | on | Only in the app | `quickCaptureHotKey` |
| Quick capture: shortcut | ⌥⌘N (also ⌃⌥⌘N, ⌥⇧⌘N) | Only in the app | `quickCaptureHotKeyPreset` |

## Backup

| Setting | Default | Where | Stored as |
|---|---|---|---|
| Back up to GitHub before quitting | on | Only in the app | `backupBeforeQuit` |
| Back up now | — (an action) | Only in the app | — |
